schema.text: holtburger vehicles (HBV1) — additive, capability-gated vehicle messages

value.name: Observe
value.text: receive VehicleProfile / VehicleSeat / VehicleState / VehicleFire / VehicleEvent

value.name: Pilot
value.text: may send VehicleBoard / VehicleInput / VehicleExit

value.name: DatPatch
value.text: has the vehicle DAT patch (tier 1): may be sent custom Setup DIDs

value.name: Ground
value.text: reserved (jeeps, later)

value.name: Derelict
value.text: no pilot after a bail-out: autopilot glide and descent

value.name: PilotCopy
value.text: sent to the pilot: AckInputSeq is valid

value.name: InputSubstituted
value.text: the server repeated the last input for this step (the pilot's was late)

value.name: BackPressure
value.text: the server lowered VCap (preload behind)

value.name: Land
value.text: held in Flight: slow to LandingSpeed, then Landing

value.name: Missile
value.text: fire a lightning-bolt rail; held: the next rail every 0.3 s

value.name: Bomb
value.text: rising edge: release the next bomb

value.name: Empty
value.text: the seat emptied (exit, bail, logout)

value.name: Refused
value.text: a VehicleBoard was refused; Reason says why

value.name: Busy
value.text: teleporting, dead, already seated, ...

value.name: Disabled
value.text: the server's vehicles_enabled property is off

value.name: Exit
value.text: parked / on the ground only

value.name: Bail
value.text: any altitude at or above the floor: freefall + parachute

value.name: Chute
value.text: while falling after a bail-out: open the parachute now (else it opens at 150 m above the ground)

value.name: Missile
value.text: a war-magic projectile spell launched from a rail; WeaponExt.SpellId

value.name: Bomb
value.text: free-fall bomb; Damage = blast damage at the centre, Range = blast radius, Magazine = 1

value.name: Crashed
value.text: Subject = pilot (0 if none); Cell/Pos = impact point

value.name: Bail
value.text: Subject = the player who bailed; Cell/Pos = where

value.name: Chute
value.text: Subject = the falling player; the parachute opened

value.name: Touchdown
value.text: Subject = the player; back on foot; Value = vertical speed at contact

value.name: Hit
value.text: Subject = the creature hit by a bolt; Value = damage

value.name: BombRelease
value.text: Subject = the pilot; Cell/Position = release point; Value = mass in lb; v2: Aux = the station's weapon index, Velocity = the bomb's initial velocity

value.name: Explosion
value.text: Subject = the pilot; Cell/Position = the impact point; Value = mass in lb; Aux = the station's weapon index

value.name: Rearmed
value.text: Subject = the pilot; the vehicle's guns, rails and bomb stations are full again

enum.name: VehiclePartRole
enum.text: Vehicle_Profile.PartRoles: the role in the low 16 bits; Ordnance carries a weapon index in bits 16-23

value.name: Propeller
value.text: spins about the vehicle's forward (y) axis through the part's Offset

value.name: Gear
value.text: drawn only while Parked / Takeoff / Landing

value.name: Canopy
value.text: hidden in the cockpit view

value.name: Ordnance
value.text: drawn while its weapon is loaded; the weapon index is in bits 16-23: role = 4 | (weaponIndex << 16)

field.name: Version
field.text: the writer's protocol version: 2 (1 from v1 writers)

field.name: Motion
field.text: retail MotionCommand the occupant shows to everyone (Sitting = 0x41000013)

field.name: Offset
field.text: seat position in the vehicle frame (x right, y forward, z up)

field.name: Spread
field.text: half-angle of the cone, radians

field.name: Damage
field.text: per round

field.name: Muzzle
field.text: muzzle position in the vehicle frame

type.name: VehicleWeaponExt
type.text: v2: per-weapon extras, parallel to Vehicle_Profile.Weapons (20 bytes)

field.name: MuzzleVelocity
field.text: m/s relative to the vehicle: the quarrel / bolt launch speed

field.name: Convergence
field.text: m: guns aim at the boresight point this far ahead; 0 = parallel

field.name: DragTerminal
field.text: m/s: a bomb's terminal velocity

field.name: SpellId
field.text: missiles: the war spell launched

type.name: VehiclePartDef
type.text: The vehicle's looks as data (DESIGN §5.1 rule 2): one retail Setup (0x02xxxxxx) or GfxObj (0x01xxxxxx) placed in the vehicle frame

field.name: Rotation
field.text: W, X, Y, Z

type.name: VehicleInputFrame
type.text: One 30 Hz step of pilot input (12 bytes)

field.name: Seq
field.text: the client's step index; the server consumes one per step in order

field.name: Pitch
field.text: -127..127 -> -1..1, nose up positive

field.name: Roll
field.text: right positive

field.name: Yaw
field.text: right positive (rudder)

type.name: Vehicle_ClientCapabilities
type.text: A capable client announces itself after entering the world (once per login)

type.name: Vehicle_Exit
type.text: Leave the seat: exit (parked) or bail (in the air)

type.name: Vehicle_Input
type.text: 30 Hz while seated; newest frame first, then up to 2 previous frames (redundancy)

field.name: Granted
field.text: requested AND enabled on this server

field.name: SimHz
field.text: the server's vehicle step rate (30)

type.name: Vehicle_Profile
type.text: The vehicle's type, sent once per vehicle per observing session (on first sight)

field.name: ProfileKey
field.text: e.g. hellcat-demo

field.name: StandInSetup
field.text: the base-DAT Setup every retail client is sent in CreateObject

field.name: SpeedCap
field.text: the server's current hard cap (69 m/s until M3)

field.name: LeadSeconds
field.text: client streaming: shift the load point forward by velocity x this

field.name: ObjectRadius
field.text: client streaming: object radius in landblocks while seated

field.name: PartRoleCount
field.text: 0 or PartCount

vector.name: PartRoles
vector.text: a VehiclePartRole per part, in Parts order

field.name: WeaponExtCount
field.text: 0 or WeaponCount

vector.name: WeaponExt
vector.text: one per weapon, in Weapons order

type.name: Vehicle_Seat
type.text: A seat changed (or a board was refused)

field.name: Occupant
field.text: 0 when empty

type.name: Vehicle_State
type.text: Authoritative vehicle state: 20 Hz to the pilot, 10 Hz to other observers in sight

field.name: Step
field.text: the vehicle's server step counter

field.name: AckInputSeq
field.text: the last pilot input consumed (pilot copy only; 0 otherwise)

field.name: VCap
field.text: speed cap in force for this step (profile cap, lowered by back-pressure)

field.name: Ammo
field.text: rounds left across all gun mounts

field.name: MissileMask
field.text: bit i = the i-th Missile weapon in profile order is loaded

field.name: BombMask
field.text: bit i = the i-th Bomb weapon is loaded

type.name: Vehicle_Fire
type.text: Rounds fired this step (tracers); hits arrive through the standard damage messages

field.name: DirX
field.text: unit direction x 32767

field.name: Seed
field.text: spread RNG seed of this burst

field.name: MountCount
field.text: Mount, Mount+1, … Mount+MountCount-1 each fired Count rounds this step; 1 in v1

field.name: Speed
field.text: m/s: the rounds' speed over the ground, for drawing

field.name: Aux
field.text: per Kind (BombRelease / Explosion: the station's weapon index)

field.name: Velocity
field.text: per Kind (BombRelease: the bomb's initial velocity, m/s)
